label: late-episode D1 (trials ~92-99) before an a2 choice
explanation: An episode-end timing unit. It fires almost only at D1 (99.7% of activation mass) and only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode: zero activity before trial 80, and 99.6% of mass in trials 90-99. In the top windows magnitude grows steadily over consecutive trials toward the end. It coincides with the bottom value-head bin (value < 5.22 holds 100% of mass), so it may track the value drop the agent expects near the end of the episode. Within that span it is gated by the upcoming choice a2 (the agent own computed choice, marked FUTURE at D1 but legitimate; 94% of mass when action==2). It is also stronger after a rewarded previous trial (89% of mass at in_rew==1). Taken together this is an asymmetric late-episode signal that also carries choice and reward. Dev scores: phase D1 & ep_trial>=90 alone gives recall 0.97, mass 0.99, precision 0.31. Adding action==2 and ep_trial>=92 gives F1 0.65, mass 0.92. Adding prev_reward==1 or ep_trial>=95 gives F1 0.67, a small gain that does not justify the extra clause. The closest predicate without the upcoming choice is D1 & ep_trial>=93 (F1 0.56, mass 0.95). It does not fire at GO, almost never at D2, and never earlier in the episode. It is weak before a1 choices and in episodes where S1 stays good.
